Lost START reply: same remote job resumed
Expired deadline, wrong blob/support/result binding and corrupted blob refused
Bounded HEALTH/STATUS inspection, duplicate job query deduplicated, tokens omitted
R1/R2 known recipe update, exact rollback, unknown edits preserved, lost-save readback
Python3.9 syntax, ZIP/TXT equality and no JavaScript members
